verdict.rationale: Mercury is a SaaS banking platform, and whether its source is open is a fair openness question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows public GitHub repos only for peripheral tooling (a Stainless-generated Go SDK, agent skills, a CLI), with no license stated. Nothing shows the core product's source is readable under an open license, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
